事后苏衣衣三人被处罚当着全校的面给时笙道歉，还是全校大会的时候。

苏衣衣气得不轻，不就是不敢得罪许乘月吗？就知道欺负她们这些没钱没势的！

那天的事那么多人看见了，自然有人传了出去，苏衣衣栽赃陷害别人，名声受到一些影响，走在路上都有人对她指指点点，苏衣衣更是将时笙恨得牙痒痒。

本来就因为他和凌浩走得近，惹了一些女生嫉妒，这事一出，苏衣衣在学校的日子也不好过，偏偏凌浩不在，南宫景在国外出差。

苏衣衣这几天可谓是过得很艰难。

至于时笙的身份，因为之前就传出被包养的事，大家都觉得是她后面的金主势力大。

安安和夏柠因为被处罚的事，对时笙的意见更大，但也只敢言语针对，她们可不想被这个女人叫来的律师在轰炸一番。

时笙忙着找房子，也没空理会这些人。

她觉得要是在和苏衣衣住下去，她会被恶心死。

也不知是不是她运气好，正好有一个学生要出国留学。一套公寓空下来，离学校很近，时笙二话不说就接了下来，不过要重新装修，她还得在学校住一段时间。

……

时笙交完房款，从公寓下来，就遇到了两个她绝对不想看到的人。

南宫景搂着苏衣衣，和时笙狭路相逢。

时笙心底开始挠墙，这特么的什么概率，这都能遇上，剧情君你不把女配作死不舒服是不是！

“许乘月，你这么阴魂不散有意思吗？”南宫景冷眼看着挡路的女人，下巴抬得高高，睥睨天下的霸道范儿。

阴魂不散你大爷，老子呵呵你一脸。

时笙扫了眼苏衣衣，她小鸟依人的贴着南宫景，眼角眉梢都带着得意。

但是她一说话就是一副柔柔弱弱，委屈到极致的模样，“许小姐，上次的事，对不起，我不是故意的，当时我被撞得有些晕，不知道她们会那么说你，之后我也当着全校的面给你道歉了，你就原谅我吧……”

这话说得漂亮啊，把自己完完全全的给摘出去了。

本宝宝给你点个赞！

一听苏衣衣提起这茬，南宫景的神色就更冷了，极为不耐烦的道：“许乘月，你从宿舍搬出来。”

“南宫景，你脑残剧看多了吧？”

妈的，这学校是你家开的啊，你让搬就搬？

南宫景眉心猛跳，“别挑战我的耐性。”

Afterwards, Su Yiyi and the other three were punished to apologize to Shi Sheng in front of the whole school, during the whole school meeting.

Su Yiyi was so angry, didn't she just dare not offend Xu Chengyue?I just know how to bully them who have no money and power!

So many people saw what happened that day, so naturally someone spread the word. Su Yiyi framed others, and her reputation was affected. People pointed at her when she walked on the street. Su Yiyi hated Shi Sheng until her teeth itched.

Originally, because he and Ling Hao were close, some girls were jealous. Once this happened, Su Yiyi had a hard time at school, but Ling Hao was not around and Nangong Jing was on a business trip abroad.

Su Yiyi has been having a very difficult time these days.

As for Shi Sheng's identity, because it was rumored that she was being adopted before, everyone thought that the financial backer behind her was powerful.

An An and Xia Ning were more dissatisfied with Shi Sheng because of the punishment, but they only dared to verbally target him. They didn't want to be bombarded by the lawyer called by this woman.

Shi Sheng was busy looking for a house and had no time to pay attention to these people.

She felt that if she stayed with Su Yiyi, she would be disgusted to death.

I don’t know if she was lucky, but there happened to be a student who was going to study abroad.An apartment became available and was very close to the school. Shi Sheng took it without saying anything, but she had to live in the school for a while before it could be renovated.

…

After Shi Sheng paid the rent and came down from the apartment, she met two people she absolutely didn't want to see.

Nangong Jing hugged Su Yiyi and met Shi Sheng on a narrow road.

Shi Sheng started scratching his head in his heart. There is no chance of this happening. Plot master, don’t you feel uncomfortable if you don’t kill the female supporting actor?

"Xu Chengyue, is it interesting that you are so haunted?" Nangong Jing looked coldly at the woman blocking the road, raising his chin high, looking down at the domineering person in the world.

The ghost of you is still lingering, uncle, and I’m looking down on you.

Shi Sheng glanced at Su Yiyi. She was leaning against Nangong Jing, with pride in her eyes and brows.

But when she spoke, she looked weak and aggrieved to the extreme, "Miss Xu, I'm sorry about what happened last time. I didn't mean it. I was knocked unconscious at the time. I didn't know they would say that to you. After that, I also apologized to you in front of the whole school. Please forgive me..."

These words are beautifully said, and they completely remove themselves.

This baby gives you a thumbs up!

As soon as Su Yiyi mentioned this, Nangong Jing's expression became even colder, and he said extremely impatiently: "Xu Chengyue, please move out of the dormitory."

"Nangong Jing, have you watched too many stupid dramas?"

Damn it, this school is run by your family, so you can move it if you ask me to?

Nangong Jing's eyebrows jumped sharply, "Don't challenge my patience."
